additional_info.subject: ID0387468-DC/Si-D/FR[170003392] - Thermal tests CRM:00315001987
additional_info.body:
Dear Jessica,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S3 170003392
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
qe4VuB
Problem Description
: Charger not working at -20ºC
Troubleshooting
:
As we already aligned, I will make a brief summary of what we discussed:
Since the charger was offline during the tests, the logs are now very scrambled and very hard to troubleshoot since the timestamps are all random.
Since the Debug Mode was also not enabled, it was not possible to check the status of the heater and temperature.
What I could see in the logs from yesterday is that the charging sessions did not start because of the Backend not accepting the NULL idTag.
This happens when you have the OCPP connected URL but have the authentication disabled. The “free” sessions appear as “NULL” and since the backend doesn't accept this, it shows the result: “Invalid”
After our session today with the customer, we were able to charge perfectly by removing the OCPP URL.
What was reported was that the charger couldn't start charging with -20ºC and that the main circuit breaker of the room was tripped after the restart.
For this case, we already asked the customer for more information on the location such as all the devices that are connected to this breaker and what is his limit.
We also arranged for the test together to check the temperature while charging.
Please let me know when the date is and let's solve this!
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387468
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
